description: Look up live US import tariff rates by HS code, product keyword or Chinese product name (e.g. 8703.24, laptop, steel pipe, 笔记本电脑, 运动相机, aluminum profile from vn). Returns base MFN rate, Forced-labor security layer, Section 301 (China), Section 232 (steel/aluminum), stacked total and origin country, daily-updated, with Chinese labels (productZh). Call this first for any tariff question.

query.description: HS code (e.g. '8703.24') or product keyword (e.g. 'laptop', 'steel pipe'). Free-text is fine; being specific improves precision. Example: '8703.24'.

name: tariff.lookup
